sites.editing: Pịa okwu iji degharịa ha, ma ọ bụ rute ha site na Tab. Enter na-edebe ha, Escape na-eweghachi ha.
sites.pointing: Pịa akụkụ peeji ahụ, ma ọ bụ rute ya site na Tab wee pịa Enter, wee jụọ {name} maka ya.
sites.pointed: Na-atụ aka n’akụkụ a: kwuo n’igbe ihe a ga-agbanwe
sites.notHere: Enweghị ike ịgbanwe okwu ndị a ebe a: peeji ahụ nwere ha karịa otu ugboro, ma ọ bụ ha esighị na faịlụ ya. Rịọ {name} ka ọ gbanwee ha.
sites.onlyWords: Naanị okwu na-agbanwe ebe a, ọ dịghịkwa nke a ga-ahapụ efu: ọ laghachila otu o dị na mbụ.
sites.shape: Jiri mkpụrụedemede 3 ruo 40 site na a ruo z, ọnụọgụ na ahịrị nkewa.
sites.held: E jidere adreesị a, ka onye ọ bụla ghara imehie onye nwe saịtị ahụ.
sites.public: Onye ọ bụla nwere ike imepe ya, igwe ọchụchọ na-egosikwa ya.
sites.year: Ọ ga-anọ n’ịntanetị otu afọ. Mbipụta ọ bụla na-emegharị ya.
sites.formWaits: Fọm ya enweghị ike iziga azịza ugbu a.
sites.formReplies: Ihe ndị ọbịa na-eziga site na fọm ya na-abịa ebe a, n’ime nchịkọta. Ruo mgbe ahụ, onye nnabata na-edebe ya n’akara, kacha otu ọnwa.
sites.codeShape: Otu asatọ nke mkpụrụedemede anọ, 0 ruo 9 na A ruo F.
sites.wrongCode: Koodu a anaghị ebipụta adreesị a.
sites.keep: Debe koodu mgbake a n’ebe nchekwa. Site na ya, ngwaọrụ ọzọ nwere ike ibipụta saịtị a ọzọ. Na-enweghị ngwaọrụ a ma ọ bụ koodu ahụ, ọ dịghị onye nwere ike ịgbanwe ya.

sites.changed.other: Faịlụ {count} gbanwere kemgbe e bipụtara ya.

sites.same: Ọ dịghị ihe gbanwere kemgbe e bipụtara ya.
sites.confirmOffline: Wepụ saịtị a n’ịntanetị? Adreesị ya ka bụ nke gị ruo otu afọ.
sites.elsewhere: E bipụtara saịtị a site na ngwaọrụ ọzọ. Dee koodu mgbake ya iji bipụta ya site ebe a.
sites.failed: Enweghị ike ibipụta saịtị ahụ. Lelee njikọ ịntanetị gị wee nwaa ọzọ.
sites.tooBig: Saịtị ahụ buru ibu nke ukwuu ibipụta. Mee ka foto ya pere mpe, ma ọ bụ jiri ole na ole, wee nwaa ọzọ.
sites.names: E wereela ọtụtụ adreesị ọhụrụ site ebe a taa. Nwaa ọzọ echi.
sites.busy: E zigala ọtụtụ mgbanwe site ebe a n’ime otu awa gara aga. Nwaa ọzọ n’ime otu awa.
sites.confirmNewCode: Mee koodu mgbake ọhụrụ? Koodu ochie ahụ, na ngwaọrụ ọ bụla i wepụrụ, agaghịzi enwe ike ịgbanwe saịtị a. Ngwaọrụ gị ndị ọzọ ga-enweta koodu ọhụrụ ahụ.
sites.newCodeMade: Koodu mgbake ochie anaghịzi arụ ọrụ maka saịtị a.
sites.newCodeFailed: E meghị koodu mgbake ọhụrụ. Lelee njikọ ịntanetị gị wee nwaa ọzọ.
